view_detail: original for all three view_image calls

copy.observed: 코르크 받침 · 스테인리스 집게 · 실리콘 턱

mandatory_conditions.required: 사진적 표현, 성인 한 명의 한 손 사용; 팔·상반신 연결
mandatory_conditions.observed: Navy shirt torso at right continuously joins exposed forearm, wrist and one hand. Index touches rear lever; only one adult and one hand are visible.

mandatory_conditions.required: 원통형 코르크 받침 위 스테인리스 스프링 집게와 앞 실리콘 두 턱, 뒤 레버
mandatory_conditions.observed: Cork cylinder, metal clip, pivot spring and rear lever are present in lower foreground. Dark pads are present, but lower pad is on the outer body and does not clearly oppose the upper pad at paper contact. Coils appear gold/brassy.

mandatory_conditions.required: 누르면 앞 턱이 열리고 놓으면 종이 잡는 기능 자체 식별
mandatory_conditions.observed: Finger contact on the raised rear lever and gripped upright paper suggest release phase. Opposing-jaw contact is ambiguous because the second pad is displaced.
Holder and cylinder are fully framed and focused. Both pads visible, though misplaced.
Cork irregular pores, brushed metal bends, matte dark pads, gently textured uncoated paper, and skin sheen differ. Spring has an unintended brassy hue.

mandatory_conditions.required: 각 문자열 한 번, 추가 메모·로고·가짜 문자 없음
mandatory_conditions.observed: All six strings printed once on paper; no extra copy or logo. A soft plant, book and pen appear at far left in the photographed background.

mandatory_conditions.required: 가상 제품, 미제공 치수·성능·정확한 모델 재현 주장 없음
mandatory_conditions.observed: No dimensions or fabricated performance claims in the image or delivery.

typography: Paper upper-left title is bold and open; native Korean strokes and spacing are clean. All six strings readable at 720 width. Long material line remains readable; 320 is sufficient for first-look hierarchy but tiny URL not for full copy certification.
space: Paper dominates upper-left and connects lower edge to clamp; the torso and connected arm occupy right third. Clear desk margin around cork base. Paper information is broad and airy rather than compressed into footer.
material: Lower foreground spring coils look brass/gold rather than stainless. Lower dark pad at front of metal body is not at the same paper contact as upper pad.
ai_slop: No fake type or random badges. Jaw-pad mismatch is a mechanical ambiguity at lower center. Background plant/book/pen were not requested and have no communication role; remove them in correction to simplify.

uncertainties: Single still frame suggests release phase but cannot prove dynamic motion. The initial pad layout makes clamping mechanism unclear.

correction_decision.reason: Move both pads to opposed paper-contact jaws and make spring silver stainless; remove incidental left background props, preserve legible printed paper, adult connection, lighting and composition.
